authority: DRLink AI Identity and AI Access remain the final per-call authorization authority. The relay must not rewrite a DENY into success or invent tools.
reviewer_network: These fixtures do not require a private production network. A public reviewer account and endpoint remain owner-gated. No login, password, or live challenge token is stored here.

positive.title: Discover advertised tools after connect
positive.user_prompt: List the tools my connected DataRelay Link server advertises.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin calls tools/list on the connected upstream and returns that server's tools without renaming them or rewriting descriptions, schemas, securitySchemes, _meta, or annotations.
positive.expected_result_shape: JSON-RPC result.tools is the upstream array. Each tool keeps its name, description, inputSchema, outputSchema when present, annotations, securitySchemes, and _meta.
positive.fixture_data: Local mock upstream advertises read_file and write_file. No reviewer account is included; a public reviewer login remains owner-gated.

positive.title: Read an allowed file
positive.user_prompt: Read a file on a host my connected DataRelay Link server already authorizes.
positive.expected_behavior: The relay forwards tools/call unchanged. The read succeeds only when upstream DRLink AI Access allows it.
positive.expected_result_shape: JSON-RPC tools/call result from upstream, including its content or structuredContent. The relay does not add a success the upstream did not return.
positive.fixture_data: Local mock tool name read_file. The file path must be one the connected DRLink policy allows. No production path or credential is stored in this fixture.

positive.title: Write an allowed file
positive.user_prompt: Write a file on an authorized host only when DataRelay Link AI Access allows that change.
positive.expected_behavior: The relay forwards the write tools/call. A write succeeds only when upstream DRLink AI Access allows it. destructiveHint stays the value the upstream tool advertised.
positive.expected_result_shape: JSON-RPC tools/call result from upstream. A denied write stays an upstream error or denial result, not a relay-invented success.
positive.fixture_data: Local mock tool name write_file. Content and path must already be allowed by the connected server policy. No production credential is stored here.

positive.title: Safety annotations stay upstream-owned
positive.user_prompt: Show readOnlyHint, openWorldHint, and destructiveHint for the tools my connected server advertises.
positive.expected_behavior: The relay does not invent or rewrite annotations. A read-only tool stays read-only, and a destructive tool stays destructive, exactly as upstream sent them.
positive.expected_result_shape: tools/list annotations objects are byte-for-value identical to the upstream tools, including readOnlyHint, openWorldHint, and destructiveHint.
positive.fixture_data: Local mock read_file is read-only and non-destructive. Local mock write_file is destructive. Live DRLink tool names stay upstream-owned.

positive.title: Reconnect and repeat an allowed read
positive.user_prompt: Reconnect my plugin session, then read an authorized file again on the same connected DataRelay Link server.
positive.expected_behavior: Refresh keeps the same plugin subject binding. The repeated tools/call is still decided only by upstream DRLink AI Access.
positive.expected_result_shape: After refresh, tools/call returns the upstream result for the same allowed read. The relay does not substitute another subject's server.
positive.fixture_data: Same local read_file fixture as an allowed read. Reviewer OAuth refresh uses the owner-gated public account, which is not stored in this repository.

negative.title: Upstream AI Access denial
negative.user_prompt: Read a file that my connected DataRelay Link server denies.
negative.expected_fallback: The relay returns the upstream denial unchanged and does not describe the read as successful.
negative.why_not_complete: DRLink AI Access is the final authority. Completing the read would rewrite a DENY into success.

negative.title: Missing plugin authentication
negative.scenario: Send tools/list or tools/call with no plugin bearer token.
negative.expected_fallback: The relay returns only its own authentication challenge and does not dial the upstream DRLink server.
negative.why_not_complete: An unauthenticated plugin request must fail closed. Inventing tool results or annotations would bypass the relay auth seam.

negative.title: Unbound or other subject's server
negative.user_prompt: Use a DataRelay Link server this plugin subject has not connected, or another subject's binding.
negative.expected_fallback: The relay denies the request and does not fall back to a global upstream or to another tenant's server.
negative.why_not_complete: The plugin subject has no connected server for that host. Completing the call would cross tenants or open a proxy.
